evals.prompt: ทำโลโก้ให้ร้านกาแฟชื่อ Moonbrew แนวมินิมอล อยากได้ไฟล์ svg เอาไว้ทำ app icon ด้วย
evals.expected_output: brand/ package: wordmark SVGs (light+dark variants), app icons, concept doc; path-based SVG, no <text> elements

assertions.text: no SVG uses a <text> element (all text converted to paths)
both a light-background and a dark-background variant exist
an app-icon asset exists (square viewBox, container tile)
a concept document (markdown) explains the design
generator script(s) exist so assets can be regenerated (not hand-only SVGs)

evals.prompt: I'm launching a fintech app called Lynx. Need a logo that works as an app icon and looks good in dark mode. Brand color should be some kind of teal.
evals.expected_output: logo package with teal primary, dark-mode variant that is legible, app icon set, concept doc

assertions.text: no SVG uses a <text> element (all text converted to paths)
primary brand color is in the teal family (hue roughly 160-210)
a dedicated dark-mode variant exists and its mark is light-colored (legible on dark)
an app-icon asset exists (square viewBox, container tile)
a concept document (markdown) explains the design

evals.prompt: ขอโลโก้ร้านเบเกอรี่ 'ป้าแดงเบเกอรี่' โทนอบอุ่นๆ เอาไปตั้งเป็นรูปโปรไฟล์เพจ Facebook
evals.expected_output: profile-ready assets that survive circular crop, PNG export included (Facebook rejects SVG), warm palette, Thai text handled as paths

assertions.text: PNG export exists (Facebook profile upload rejects SVG)
profile asset is square 1:1 at 512px or larger
no SVG uses a <text> element (Thai text must be paths — renders wrong without the font otherwise)
palette is warm (reds/oranges/browns dominate, not default blue/green)
mark content stays inside the inscribed circle of the tile (survives circular crop)
a concept document (markdown) explains the design
